test_title: All India SSC MTS & Havaldar 2025: Marks Booster Mega Live Test - 04
subject: general
question: Which of the following article is/are never suspended during emergency?
solution:
The correct option is __**20 and 21**__.

__
 
• Article 19 which deals with the freedom of speech is automatically suspended during emergencies.
 
• **The articles which are never suspended during an emergency are article 20 and article 21**__.
 __
 
• Article 20 deals with protection in respect of conviction for offences.
 
• Article 21 deals with the protection of life and personal liberty.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are a total of three types of emergency mentioned in article 352, 356, and 360.
 
 
• Article 352 deals with a national emergency. 
 
• Article 356 deals with state emergency.
 
• Article 360 deals with a financial emergency.
